description: For a US stock ticker: the likely catalysts behind a move, from primary sources, in seconds. Ranks the last 48 hours (adjustable) of SEC filings: 8-K events decoded into plain English (deals, earnings, new debt, unregistered share sales, delisting notices, management changes), the press-release headline from Exhibit 99.1, offerings and shelf registrations (dilution), insider open-market buys and sells from Form 4 (who, shares, price, value), 5%+ stakes (13D/13G); plus whether the stock is halted or was halted today and why. Each item has its time, a link to the filing and why it ranks where it does; filing bursts say which filing to read first. An explicit answer status (filing_found, news_halt_no_filing_yet, unexplained_by_primary_sources) and a coverage block (window searched, when each source was last checked, latest filing date) let an agent tell "nothing filed" apart from "a source failed". Facts only: no price data and no buy/sell opinions.

hours.description: How far back to look, in hours (default 48).

title: Why is this stock moving?
